prompt_summary: LLM diagnosis of answer key self-test failure

parsed_result.rationale: The grader penalized the answer key when grading itself because its heuristics expect SQL/text in specific fields (artifacts.code) and apply strict sub-scores (e.g., transformation max awarded < full points). The answer key places runnable SQL in artifacts.commands (not artifacts.code) and otherwise follows the schema, so the script incorrectly deducted points.
parsed_result.recommendation: Regenerate the grading script (task_evaluation.py) to correctly inspect both artifacts.code and artifacts.commands for SQL/queries and to align section sub-scores with intended maxima (adjust transformation scoring logic).
